zones.label: Rate card & team (baseline)
zones.description: The AS-IS team, its rate card and location mix: the cost baseline every saving is measured against.

zones.label: Scope & automation potential
zones.description: Which artefacts and phases are in scope, the lifecycle posture, the engagement context and the glass ceiling that caps automation.

zones.label: Adoption curve (S-curve)
zones.description: The shape and timing of adoption: S-curve control points, curve families, fitted ramps and maturity thresholds.

zones.label: Knowledge Hub & KT
zones.description: The shared knowledge hub: potential multiplier, hub setup and run cost, knowledge-transfer savings and the with/without comparison.

zones.label: Run sizing, setup & taxes
zones.description: Parameters that size the cost of running agents: setup lines, the token price, the supervision ceiling, the verification tax and the rework loops.

zones.label: Time Engine & annual model
zones.description: The annual flat-step model, the monthly Time Engine built from it and the discounted-cash-flow kernel: one source of the savings, the run cost, payback, NPV and ROI.

zones.label: Readiness & programme tuning
zones.description: Readiness index, eligibility gate, operating model, maturity tracks and programme blocks: analytical, they do not feed the euro result.

zones.label: Stress (scenarios, sensitivity, Monte Carlo)
zones.description: Scenarios, one-at-a-time sensitivity and the seeded Monte Carlo, for a case and for a portfolio.

zones.label: Product resolution (portfolio)
zones.description: Turns a portfolio into one effective case per product: common values, overrides, own team and the single-case run.

zones.label: Economics headline
zones.description: The money headline derived once from the Time Engine: total benefit, setup, net, ROI, payback, NPV and the cost reduction.

zones.label: Delivery views (team, KPIs, story)
zones.description: Views read from the engine: target team and FTE, KPI scorecard, velocity, Gantt, compliance, playback, story and commercial.

zones.label: Verification & verdict
zones.description: The automatic logic checks, convergence rows, due-diligence register, strategies and the decision verdict.

zones.label: Consolidation (waves & series)
zones.description: Products on the portfolio calendar: waves, additive monthly series and the consolidated headline of a portfolio, a wave or a product.

zones.label: Aggregated views (portfolio / wave)
zones.description: Per-section aggregate tables of the View selector: a row per product and a total, always read from the consolidation.

zones.label: Exports (Excel, report, HTML)
zones.description: Files written from the case: the cost-model and parameters workbooks, the report, HTML snapshots and the snapshot library.

zones.label: Workspace & configuration
zones.description: Navigation, personas, the Board and its variable registry, the Factory meta-model and the dependency registry: configuration that reads the model but adds no calculation.

zones.label: Foundation (types, context, inputs)
zones.description: Shared plumbing: case types, the engine context, the typed inputs seam, memo helpers and barrels. Reported, never drawn as a dependency.

zones.label: Presentation formatting
zones.description: The single owners of money and number text shared by screens and exports. Reported, never drawn as a dependency.

figures.label: Total benefit
figures.description: Sum of the yearly savings over the horizon.

figures.label: Net benefit
figures.description: Total benefit minus setup.

figures.label: ROI
figures.description: Net benefit divided by setup (null when nothing is invested): the rule of the cash-flow kernel.

figures.label: Payback month
figures.description: First month whose cumulative cash-flow is non-negative (the cash-flow kernel).

figures.label: Payback year
figures.description: Horizon year that contains the payback month.

figures.label: NPV
figures.description: Net present value of the monthly cash-flow at the case discount rate (the cash-flow kernel).

figures.label: Saving % over the horizon
figures.description: Net cost reduction over the horizon as a share of the AS-IS cost.

figures.label: Setup cost
figures.description: Setup lines plus the change cost and the hub setup.

figures.label: AS-IS baseline cost
figures.description: Annual cost of the AS-IS team, the reference of every saving.

figures.label: Run cost per year
figures.description: Team, token, infrastructure and agentic run team cost of each year.

figures.label: Savings per year
figures.description: Yearly savings aggregated from the monthly Time Engine rows.

figures.label: Effective automation
figures.description: Automation depth after posture, context and hub, capped by the glass ceiling.

figures.label: Glass ceiling
figures.description: Effort-weighted human supervision of the scope: the cap on automation.

figures.label: Verification tax
figures.description: Share of the saving given back to human verification of agent output.

figures.label: Agentic run team
figures.description: Agent vFTE, run FTE and run cost per horizon year.

figures.label: Token volume
figures.description: Annual token volume per horizon year.

figures.label: Knowledge-transfer saving
figures.description: Annual cost avoided by the Knowledge Hub on knowledge transfer.

figures.label: FTE before / after
figures.description: Total human FTE at entry and at the horizon end, and the reduction.

figures.label: Velocity uplift
figures.description: Delivery velocity at the horizon end versus the AS-IS anchor.

figures.label: KPI scorecard
figures.description: AS-IS versus horizon-end indicators.

figures.label: Decision verdict
figures.description: Go, conditional or reconsider, from the Monte Carlo distribution.

figures.label: Monte Carlo distribution
figures.description: P10 / P50 / P90 of the net benefit over the seeded draws.

figures.label: Portfolio headline
figures.description: Net, ROI, payback and NPV of the portfolio, a wave or a product on the calendar.
